build_SparseConv3d: build a SparseConv3d layer with specified in_channels, out_channels, and kernel_size for 3D sparse convolution
build_SparseConv2d: build a SparseConv2d layer with specified in_channels, out_channels, and kernel_size for 2D sparse convolution
build_SubMConv3d: build a SubMConv3d submanifold sparse convolution layer for 3D sparse tensor processing
build_SparseConvTranspose3d: build a SparseConvTranspose3d transposed sparse convolution layer for upsampling 3D sparse tensors
build_SparseInverseConv3d: build a SparseInverseConv3d inverse sparse convolution layer using a shared indice_key with its forward conv
